scope: Whole 1987 MSX2 game rebuilt as a 1995 3D stealth adventure, source-authored Unreal project
sourcePriority: MSX2 script, maps and multiple independent walkthroughs
later-series narrative continuity as context only
nonCanonToolRule: No stun pistol in normal or shipping inventory. Opt-in developer-only, default false; keep source as a test harness.

vocab.partial_source_greybox: level/mission code exists; not UE verified
vocab.source_prototype: Unreal logic source exists; not compiled/played
vocab.unreal_verified: actual UE compilation, PIE video and automated runtime tests

qualityDefinition: No level or boss is complete merely because its data/mesh/C++ exists; gameplay, visuals, audio, accessibility, controller and performance must be demonstrated in Unreal.

bosses.name: Four Mercenaries
bosses.sourceFunction: earlier combat squad challenge, not a new 3D named boss
bosses.threeDInterpretation: Squad encounter with coordinated sightlines, weapon reload windows and multiple room approaches
bosses.approvedCounterplay: Stealth/weapon positioning; no mandatory new weapon
buildRules: only attacks proven by source or clearly labelled remake interpretation
each attack needs readable aim/windup/active/recovery
mechanical hitbox and physical muzzle must match authored animation
dialogue and boss knowledge cannot reveal later-game identity or spoilers
reload/action changes must be physically appropriate and interruption-safe
